name: select
title: Auro Select
description: Typed, accessible single-select listbox. Logic lives in the framework-free @auro/headless core; the React render layer is copied into your repo and yours to edit.

a11y.ariaActivedescendant: trigger tracks the highlighted option; focus stays on the trigger
keyboard: Enter/Space/ArrowDown/ArrowUp open the listbox and seed the highlight
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move the highlight (skipping disabled options)
Home/End jump to first/last enabled option
Enter/Space commit the highlighted option and close
Escape closes the listbox, keeping the current value

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }>

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when no option is selected.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Fired with the selected option's value when the user makes a selection.

auro.docs: Import { Select } and pass `options`. Control it via `value` + `onValueChange`, or use `defaultValue` for uncontrolled usage. Set `placeholder` for the empty state and `disabled` to inactivate the control.
